snippet.title: Brimstone | trailer 1
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3781330/Brimstone/

Brimstone is a fast-paced first-person shooter inspired by old and modern classics. Set in a world with a blend of both fantasy and sci-fi, now besieged by horrible monsters from an unknown realm. Use powerful guns, tactical magic, and pegasus wings to drive back the horrors and save your people. 

It's time to fight fire... with Brimstone.
